business: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider designing, manufacturing, assembling and testing consumer electronics, mobile phones, telecom equipment, IT hardware and home appliances for global OEMs. Revenue from manufacturing services and backward-integrated component manufacturing.

segments.name: Mobile Phones & Other EMS
segments.comment: Largest segment; strong Indian smartphone manufacturing position despite near-term headwinds

segments.name: Telecom & Networking
segments.comment: Highest growth vertical; expanding into complex backhaul solutions, optical transceivers

segments.name: IT Hardware
segments.comment: At inflection point; mass producing laptops, AIOs; 60:40 JV with Inventec

segments.name: Home Appliances
segments.comment: Diversified platform; washing machines, refrigerators; expanding capacity toward ODM

segments.name: Consumer Electronics
segments.comment: LED TVs transitioning to ODM; refrigerators scaling to 2M units annually

segments.name: Lighting
segments.comment: 50:50 JV with Signify; consolidating market position; expanding exports

segments.name: Wearables & Hearables
segments.comment: 50:50 JV with Imagine Marketing; expanding into smartwatches, dash cams

segments.name: Component Manufacturing
segments.comment: Camera modules 70M→190M units, displays with ECMS support, AC-PCB 50:50 JV

revenue_mix: Global customer base with exports to Africa, US, Europe via supply diversification. Mobile phones and IT hardware primary export segments; domestic market across all product categories.
strategy: Scale EMS manufacturing platform across mobile, telecom, IT hardware, home appliances
Backward integrate high-value components: displays, camera modules, optical transceivers
Transition to ODM/JDM design-led partnerships and solution-centric manufacturing
Localise BOM; reduce import dependence for supply-chain resilience
Diversify customer base; expand into higher-value premium segments
outlook: Long-term India electronics opportunity supported by global supply diversification, increasing localisation, and PLI/ECMS government policies expected to drive sustainable profitable growth despite near-term challenges.
capex_plans: Noida 1M sq ft Mobile facility, Tirupati Home Appliances 0.6M→0.9M units, Chennai IT Hardware expansion, Camera modules 70M→190M units, Display facility with ECMS, Refrigerator 375K sq ft.
risks: Global demand cycles and macroeconomic sensitivity affecting order volumes and capacity utilization
High customer concentration; large OEM partners may alter sourcing or reduce volumes
Structurally thin EMS margins; intense competition from established global multi-geography players
Import dependence on semiconductors, display panels and advanced modules creates vulnerability
flags: Related party transactions pending shareholder approval for four subsidiaries. Cost auditor fee Rs. 3.75L p.a. Final dividend Rs. 10/share (FV Rs. 2). Multiple JVs with external partners.
